definition_zh: 秋天的；秋季的；已过盛年的；萧瑟的
definition_en: of, relating to, or typical of autumn; also, past the peak of life or vigour
core_image: 一年走到成熟与凋落之间的那段金色时光
scene: 桂香浮起，梧桐叶落在石阶上。The garden had an autumnal calm in late October.
sceneCN: 这里 autumnal 指「秋天的」（第 1 个义项：秋季的、带秋意的）；句意：十月末的花园透着一派秋日的宁静。

pos.zh: 秋天的；秋季的；晚年的；萧瑟的

derivatives.zh: 春天的（相对词，出自拉丁 vernalis）

senses.title: Of the season autumn
senses.definition: belonging to or characteristic of autumn
senses.definitionCN: 属于秋天或具有秋天特征的
senses.example: The autumnal equinox balances day and night.
senses.why: The adjective attaches directly to the Latin season word autumnus.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词直接挂在拉丁语季节词 autumnus 之上。

senses.title: Of harvest and ripeness
senses.definition: of the harvest time or the ripening of crops and fruit
senses.definitionCN: 指收获时节或庄稼、果实的成熟
senses.example: Autumnal orchards hung heavy with late apples.
senses.exampleCN: 秋日的果园挂满晚熟的苹果，沉甸甸的。
senses.why: Autumn was the Roman harvest season, so the word keeps the ripeness within it.
senses.whyCN: 秋天本是罗马的收获季，这个词里始终藏着「成熟」。

senses.title: Of the year's later months
senses.definition: of the later part of the year, especially September to November
senses.definitionCN: 指一年较晚的时段，尤其是九至十一月
senses.example: An autumnal chill settled over the village.
senses.why: Calendars divide the year, and the adjective marks the third quarter.
senses.whyCN: 历法把一年分段，这个形容词标出第三季。

senses.title: Past the prime of life
senses.definition: of a person or career, past the peak, in a later phase
senses.definitionCN: 指人或事业已过巅峰、处于后段
senses.example: The poet's autumnal works are gentler than his early verses.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人晚期的作品比早年诗行更为温缓。
senses.why: The year becomes a life: spring is youth, autumn is the wise decline.
senses.whyCN: 一年即一生：春为青春，秋为渐老中的从容。

senses.title: Melancholy and wistful
senses.definition: of a mood, tinged with gentle sadness, like fading leaves
senses.definitionCN: （心境）带淡淡哀愁，如落叶般怅然
senses.example: There was something autumnal in her farewell letters.
senses.exampleCN: 她的告别信里透着一股秋意般的惆怅。
senses.why: Falling leaves and shortening days teach a soft melancholy; the word absorbed it.
senses.whyCN: 落叶与渐短的白昼教会人淡淡的哀愁，这个词把这份哀愁吸了进去。

senses.title: Of warm colors
senses.definition: of the orange, red, and brown colors of the season
senses.definitionCN: 指橙、红、褐等秋天特有的色彩
senses.example: She chose autumnal shades for the dining room.
senses.exampleCN: 她为餐厅挑了秋色的暖调。
senses.why: Design borrows the season's palette, and the adjective names it.
senses.whyCN: 设计界借用季节的调色盘，这个形容词为其命名。

senses.title: In astronomy and the calendar
senses.definition: of celestial events occurring in or named for autumn, as the autumnal equinox
senses.definitionCN: 指发生在秋季或以秋季命名的事件，如秋分
senses.example: The autumnal equinox marks the sun's crossing southward.
senses.exampleCN: 秋分标志着太阳南移越过赤道。
senses.why: Science needed a formal adjective for the season's celestial markers.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要一个正式形容词来指称秋季的天文节点。

senses.title: Of late flourishing before an end
senses.definition: of a late period of activity or beauty just before an ending
senses.definitionCN: 指终结之前最后的活跃或盛放
senses.example: The band's autumnal reunion tour was its most graceful.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队晚期的重组巡演最为从容优雅。
senses.why: Autumn holds both ripeness and decline, so the word fits final glories.
senses.whyCN: 秋天同时承载成熟与凋零，这个词因此适用于迟来的辉煌。

intro.en: Autumnal comes from Latin autumnalis, formed on autumnus, the season of harvest; the older history of autumnus itself is uncertain, possibly Etruscan. English formed the adjective in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: autumnal 出自拉丁语 autumnalis，其基础是收获季一词 autumnus；autumnus 更早的来源不确定，或出自伊特鲁里亚语。英语形容词形成于 17 世纪。

items.en: The further source of autumnus is unknown; an Etruscan origin has been proposed but not proven.
items.cn: autumnus 的更早来源不明；有伊特鲁里亚语起源说，但未被证实。

items.en: autumnus named the harvest season, the time of ripening crops and vintage.
items.cn: 拉丁语 autumnus 指收获之季，即庄稼成熟、葡萄采收的时节。

items.en: autumnalis was the formal adjective, of or belonging to autumn.
items.cn: autumnalis 是正式形容词，意为「属于秋天的」。

items.en: The season word passed through Old French autompne into Middle English autumpne.
items.cn: 季节词经古法语 autompne 进入中古英语 autumpne。

items.en: English simplified the noun to autumn by the sixteenth century, displacing the native harvest.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪英语将名词简化为 autumn，取代了本族的 harvest 一词。

items.en: The adjective autumnal formed in the seventeenth century and quickly grew its moods and metaphors.
items.cn: 形容词 autumnal 形成于 17 世纪，很快长出各类心绪与比喻义。

note.en: Group one collects the season family and look-alikes; group two collects the four seasons' adjectives and mood words.
note.cn: 第一组收季节词族及形近词；第二组收四季形容词与相关心绪词。

entries.definition: the season itself; the noun beneath the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 秋天本身；形容词所依托的名词。

entries.definition: of spring, from Latin vernalis; the season-adjective autumnal answers to.
entries.definitionCN: 春天的，出自拉丁语 vernalis；autumnal 的对位词。
冬天的，出自拉丁语 hibernalis。

entries.definition: self-sufficient, from Greek autos plus arkein; shares only the opening sounds.
entries.definitionCN: 自给自足的，出自希腊语 autos + arkein；仅开头读音相似，词源无关。

entries.definition: a brownish-orange color, from French tanné, tanned; no season in its past.
entries.definitionCN: 黄褐色的，出自法语 tanné「鞣制的」；词源与季节无关。

entries.definition: the American name for the season, from the fall of leaves.
entries.definitionCN: 美式对秋季的称呼，源自「落叶」之意。

entries.definition: reddish-brown, the color of autumn leaves and apples.
entries.definitionCN: 红褐色的；秋叶与秋果的颜色。

entries.definition: gentle sadness; the mood autumnal often carries.
soft, rich, and ripe, like autumn light or late fruit.
entries.definitionCN: 醇熟的；柔和丰厚的，如秋光与晚果。

entries.definition: past the peak and moving toward the end.
entries.definitionCN: 衰落的；已过巅峰、走向尾声的。

normalIntro.en: autumnal is autumn plus the Latin adjective ending: the season turned into a quality.
normalIntro.cn: autumnal 即 autumn 加拉丁形容词词尾：把季节化成一种质地。

normal.en: autumn + al: keep the silent n, unlike the noun's spelling tricks.
normal.cn: autumn + al：保留不发音的 n，注意拼写变化。

normal.en: The season-adjective set: vernal, estival, autumnal, hibernal.
autumnal equinox is the set astronomical phrase.
normal.cn: autumnal equinox 是天文学固定说法：秋分。

normal.en: Figuratively: autumnal years are the years past summer's prime.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：autumnal years 即过了盛夏的人生晚境。

normal.en: Its mood is mellow, not bitter: gentle sadness like falling leaves.
normal.cn: 它的心绪是醇而非苦：如落叶般的淡淡哀愁。

abstract.en: Picture late light lying low across a stubble field.
abstract.cn: 想象低斜的秋光铺在收割后的田茬上。

abstract.en: The word smells of woodsmoke and ripe pears.
abstract.cn: 这个词闻起来有烟柴与熟梨的气息。

abstract.en: Autumnal is summer's echo growing golden and quiet.
abstract.cn: autumnal 是夏天的回声，渐渐变金、归于安静。

examples.en: The lake turned autumnal gold by the third week of October.
examples.cn: 到十月第三周，湖面已是一片秋金。

examples.en: In his autumnal years the general wrote memoirs instead of orders.
examples.cn: 晚年时分，将军写的是回忆录，不再是作战命令。

examples.en: There was an autumnal hush in the empty school corridor.
examples.cn: 空荡的学校走廊里有一种秋日般的沉静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥潭唷」——秋天的奥潭潭水凉了唷，落叶铺满岸边

root: 出自拉丁语 autumnus「秋季；收获季」+ 形容词后缀 -alis（autumnalis）；autumnus 更早来源不确定（有伊特鲁里亚语假说），名词经古法语 autompne 进入中古英语；形容词 autumnal 于 17 世纪在英语内形成，与 vernal、hibernal 同属拉丁季节形容词系列，词源需谨慎表述。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the season outward: the calendar autumn, the harvest, the late years of a life, the gentle melancholy, and the colors named after falling leaves.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项随季节向外延展：历法之秋、收获之秋、人生之晚境、淡淡的惆怅，以及以落叶命名的颜色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: golden light over ripening fields, leaves about to fall.
core.cn: 核心意象：金色秋光铺在渐熟的田野上，落叶将坠未坠。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR SIDE: the equinox and the year's third quarter.
branches.cn: 历法一面：秋分与一年的第三季。

branches.en: THE RIPE SIDE: harvest fruit and the season's warm palette.
branches.cn: 成熟一面：收获的果实与季节的暖调色。

branches.en: THE LIFE SIDE: late years and late glories.
branches.cn: 人生一面：晚境与迟来的辉煌。

branches.en: THE MOOD SIDE: melancholy like falling leaves.
branches.cn: 心绪一面：如落叶般的惆怅。

branches.en: THE FINAL SIDE: one last flourishing before the end.
branches.cn: 尾声一面：终结前最后的盛放。

intro.en: autumnal is autumnus plus -al, the standard Latin adjective ending; the season stem stays visible throughout.
intro.cn: autumnal 由 autumnus 加 -al 构成，后者是拉丁语标准形容词词尾；季节词干贯穿全词。

latinIntro.en: Latin built four season adjectives in -alis: vernalis, aestivus, autumnalis, hibernalis; English borrowed them all.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 -alis 造了四个季节形容词：vernalis、aestivus、autumnalis、hibernalis——英语全部借入。
